scoring_justification: The paper reports only qualitative trends (sign, monotonicity, three-ion dominance) without tabulated absolute γ values; T1/T2 infeasible. Structural checks on the computed CSV are the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected sign pattern of gamma_total used in step_sign_pattern
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the paper's description of structural stability trends (positive for Z>9, negative for 6<Z<9 for both Z_s; at Z=4 Z_s=1 negative, Z_s=2 positive) and confirmed by the reference solution.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's qualitative claims and the reference solution's correct CSV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The pattern matches the paper's reported physical behaviour and passes the reference oracle.

outputs.description: CSV file containing computed intrinsic stacking fault energies for fcc crystals over Z=4..11 for Z_s=1 and Z_s=2.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will read this file and verify (i) sign pattern at key Z values (positive for Z>9, negative for 6<Z<9, negative near Z=4 for Z_s=1 and positive near Z=4 for Z_s=2), (ii) overall monotonic increase of gamma_total with Z, and (iii) dominance of three-ion term |gamma_3| >> |gamma_2| for most Z, as described in the paper.

steps.description: Verify sign of gamma_total against expected structural pattern.
Check overall increasing trend of gamma_total with Z (final > initial for each Z_s).
Check that |gamma_3| dominates over |gamma_2| (|gamma_3| >= 2*|gamma_2| for all rows).
